_readme: NIL agency ledger: one row a player and source (scripts/agencies.py). agency = the firm a source names, "Family" when a relative handles his deals, "None" when a source says he has no agent. confidence high (agency page, announcement or named major-outlet report), medium (one outlet, older than a year or may be stale), low (indirect). Never guessed; a player no source names is left out.

rows.note: On3: 'Repped by Excel Sports Management' (Jordan Brand deal). On Missouri 2026-27 roster (Sports-Reference).

rows.agent: Rich Paul (agency founder; no individual agent named)
rows.note: SI (2025, before his first USC game) says he signed with Klutch. On USC 2026-27 roster. Exact publish date not shown.
Signed with CAA for NIL as a Kentucky signee. Earlier repped by Nate Conley (Court XIV). Sports-Reference: Kentucky 2025-26, Oregon 2026-27, so it may be stale after the transfer.

Mentioned in passing: Conley of Court XIV signed 'five-star recruit Anthony Thompson' (2026 class). Ohio State 2026-27 roster has an Anthony Thompson. Same-person check rests on the name and class only.
Signed in 2023 as a Link Academy sophomore (2025 class). WME absorbed BDA. On Missouri 2026-27 roster. More than 3 years old.
Solomon Ball signed a Klutch NIL representation deal as a UConn freshman. Still on UConn's 2026-27 roster. Older than 12 months.
Signed as an Oregon freshman. Now at Louisville, so it may be stale. SI's 2025 Arenas story still lists him as a Klutch college client.
On3: signed with Klutch Sports Group for NIL representation in Sept 2023, plus a Klutch Athletics/New Balance deal. Sports-Reference: Houston 2025-26, Gonzaga 2026-27.
Signed with Klutch for NIL after leaving Howard. Sports-Reference: Howard 2024-25, Creighton 2025-26, VCU 2026-27, so it may be stale.
Joined as a Kentucky signee. Sports-Reference: Villanova 2025-26, Miami 2026-27. Two school changes since.
Signed as a Michigan State signee in 2022. Now at BYU. 4 years old.
Priority's live college NIL page lists 'Braden Huff x Papatui' among its NIL deals.
Signed as a Brentwood freshman, per Thehoopspill post relayed by Sportskeeda.
Nov 2026: father Rafer Alston said Reese's mother Ashley negotiated an LSU NIL deal behind his back; Reese disputed parts of that account; no agency named

WCPO: signed with EZ Sports Group for NIL (collegiate director Tremaine Dees, founder Corey Marcum) when he moved to prep school; report likely 2024, older than 12 months; Panini deal; UC signee, reclassified to 2027
SDS: Haugh, through his agent Aaron Klevan of The TEAM, approached Florida about returning
Agency's own release 'Signs Freshman Star JT Toppin for NIL Representation' (at New Mexico); older than 12 months

FOS: Raznatovic represents four of Illinois's five Balkan players incl. Mirkovic; RealGM also lists him. FOS names the agent, not the agency (Raznatovic runs BeoBasket); agency firm inferred from the named agent
Aggregator report of CAA signing ahead of 2026 NBA Draft; he returned to college (Kansas); not confirmed by a major outlet
FOS: represented by Raznatovic (agent named, agency is his firm BeoBasket); agency firm inferred from the named agent
Sportskeeda lists a 'NIL deal with Klutch Sports Group' (2024-07-19) per his Instagram; secondary source, older than 12 months

Agent Bill Duffy (WME) told Rothstein he is returning to Arkansas for 2026-27 (per search snippet; On3 page not read). An older Rivals piece quoted Ryan Davis as his agent; source year 2026, exact date not read
SI: pro day hosted by Priority Sports, his agency, after the 2026 NBA Combine; agent not named; he returned to Alabama; source year 2026, exact date not read
FOS: represented by Raznatovic (agent named, agency is his firm BeoBasket); agency firm inferred from the named agent
FOS: 'Mullins is represented by Excel Sports'; his agent runs his NIL and social media
On3 (Jul 2025) names Dan Everett of ESM as his representative on the Wild Card trading card deal; On3 listed him as 2028 Mandarin HS WR, same player
SI: his agent Derrick Shelby (Prestige Management Group co-founder) spoke for him on the Texas Tech commitment
SI quotes 'his representatives at Fortune Sports Group' on his NIL deals (Kia, Adidas); a low-quality aggregator claims Klutch, not trusted
Gray TV story (Nov 2026): his mother and her circle help him make NIL decisions 'about agents and things of that nature'; no agency named
On3 Panini deal story: repped by Excel Sports; over 12 months old
On3 report of NIL representation signing as Alabama signee; over 12 months old
Agents Noah Reisenfeld and Adie von Gontard (Young Money APAA) named in Duke/Miami transfer coverage; attorney Darren Heitner in Duke dispute
SI says he works exclusively with Postgame NIL marketing agency for deals; article from his RS-So year, likely stale
Athletic Business: represented by Alan Zucker of Excel, which represents the Manning family
SI: switched NIL representation from NILX to Athletes First after Dec 2024 Las Vegas Bowl
Brother Dallin Leavitt (ex-NFL S) acts as his agent per On3 reporting in portal saga
BroBible: signed with Process Sports Management at North Texas; may be stale after transfer to Oklahoma State
His agents Rosenhaus and O'Dare told ESPN's Pete Thamel of Auburn commitment
On3: repped by NETWORK; mother Toni helped pick agency
Wasserman (Doug Hendrickson) dropped him Jan 8 2026; attorney Darren Heitner said he now represents him in the contract dispute; current NIL agent unknown
EssentiallySports (citing On3 Pete Nakos on deal): The Familie represents him and negotiated adidas deal
FOS: represented by father Nic, coach Cordell Landers and at least one lawyer, none certified agents; Forward Counsel negotiated 2022 Spyre deal; pre-UCLA move
On3's Pete Nakos: Panini deal, 'their reps @thebizofathlete tell On3'
On3: signed with WME for NIL representation as HS recruit; gave commitment statement through WME; over 12 months old
SI/ESPN: his agent Sam Leaf Ireife(j) told ESPN of 2026 re-signing; firm Equity Sports only from bookingagentinfo directory
On3 2024: retained representation with QB Reps as a recruit; may be stale
TCU student-run NIL venture; TCU news quotes him working with Legacy Frogs (2025)
search summary: his agents at AiC Athletes confirmed Oregon State commitment to On3 (Hayes Fawcett), Jan 2026 transfer from Mercer; not opened
SI: Panini deal announced through his agency The Business of Athletes; agent Darren Wilson quoted on deals; Wilson's tie to the firm not confirmed
CBS Sports: no typical agent, his father handled it (Dec 2025 retention deal with Florida Victorious)
